screens.screen: Checkout - form filled with a test card, ready to PAY
Checkout - after a successful test payment (green 'Payment approved' SnackBar)

notes: This repo is a thin integration demo with exactly ONE screen (CheckoutView) on the default Material 2 blue theme, English/LTR. Nothing was added: the three images are three real states of that single screen (empty, filled, success SnackBar). If three near-identical frames look weak in the portfolio, use only 2.png. The card number is masked (dots + 1111, HyperPay's public Visa test card ending) on purpose although the real field shows digits in groups of four with double spaces; CVV/expiry are test values. The brand icon in the code is Image.asset('assets/images/VISA.png'), but that asset folder is NOT in the repo (pubspec declares no assets); the Visa logo drawn is the visa.png bundled in the repo's 'Hyperpay SDK v3.10/Demo' folder. Endpoints and entity IDs in lib/constants.dart are empty, so the app as committed cannot actually complete a payment.
